audioNote.markdown:
Welcome to Sessionboard!
In this short video, we’ll show you how to create and assign a form to a portal. Portal forms are an efficient way to collect a number of detailed information all in one place from contacts, groups, or sessions using various field types—such as file uploads and dropdowns.

steps.title: Create Form

audioNote.markdown:
There are three types of forms you can create:

First, "Contacts". Collect information specific to each event contact, such as headshots and bios for the event website.

Second, "Groups". Request sponsor or exhibitor groups to provide their logo and any booth needs for the event day.

Select the type of form you would like to create and continue building your form by clicking the button 'Save & Build Form'.

Third, "Sessions". Ask speakers to share any AV requirements for each session they are associated with.

steps.title: Form Questions

audioNote.markdown: Add standard fields to your form or create custom ones using the Add Question button to collect information from contacts and groups. If you are using a native integration such as Grip or Swoogo, and would like the details you are collecting to be synced to the third-party site, we recommend using standard fields whenever possible.

audioNote.markdown: Customize Question allows you to add a field label and help text to your fields. Use Question Rules enables you to apply conditional logic so that questions appear based on responses to previous questions. Edit Fields lets you modify the field description and any additional settings based on the field type—for example, adding or removing options for a dropdown field. Finally, Remove from Form removes the field from the form without deleting it, allowing it to be used again in the future.
